System rules & unresolved details

Study grid: 600 mm coordination, 1,200 mm panel pitch, 3,600 × 2,400 mm bay between post axes. All dimensions are provisional.

One post height; two beam roles; replaceable non-load-bearing enclosure. Local object axes: X length, Y depth, Z height. Actual lengths differ from setting-out spans.

Nominal contacts use zero clearance for this fit study. Fabrication tolerances and assembly access have not been resolved.

  • Foundations, floor supports and lateral bracing are absent.
  • Wall corners need closure pieces; panel backs need rails or brackets.
  • Floor-to-wall edges and door thresholds have an 80 mm unresolved gap.
  • Roof edges, falls, waterproofing and the band above wall panels are unresolved.
  • Beam-end connections and all fasteners require design.

The two-bay assembly shares its central posts and transverse beam. It has no internal wall. Quantity counts exclude all unresolved components.

Study geometry only. Dimensions, material build-ups, joints and load paths are not resolved. These parts are independent of the current Studio and Architecture models.
